article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Caleb Jones and Jordan Watford each scored 20 points as Queens beat Wofford 97-92 on Saturday. Jones added five rebounds and five assists for the Royals (3-2). Watford went 7 of 13 from the floor and 5 for 8 from the line. Nasir Mann shot 6 of 9 from the field and 6 for 6 from the line to finish with 19 points. Cam Lowe and Chace Watley both finished with 17 points, and Lowe had eight rebounds and five assists for the Terriers (2-3). Chris Arias also had 16 points. Up next Queens plays Saturday against LSU on the road, and Wofford visits Charleston Southern on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
